<?php

namespace App\FormBuilder\Fields;

use App\FormBuilder\Concerns\HasFile;
use App\FormBuilder\Concerns\HasOptionsRepeater;
use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;

class UploadImageField extends BaseField
{
    use HasOptionsRepeater;
    use HasFile;

    /**
     * Max size in kylobytes
     * https://laravel.com/docs/12.x/validation#rule-max
     */
    public const MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE = 1024 * 3; // 3MB

    /**
     * List of allowed mime types
     * @var array<int,string>
     */
    protected array $mimes = [
        'jpeg',
        'jpg',
        'png',
        'gif',
        'webp',
    ];


    /**
     * @see HasFile::viewData()
     */
    protected string $messageType = 'image';


    public function getFakeSubmitData(): mixed
    {
        return UploadedFile::fake()->create(fake()->word . '.jpg', 100);
    }

}

<?php

namespace App\FormBuilder\Concerns;

trait HasFile
{
    /**
     * @inheritDoc
     */
    public function getSchema(): array
    {
        return [
        ];
    }

    /**
     * The view then includes the livewire component
     * that handles the file upload.
     */
    public function viewName(): string
    {
        return 'upload-file';
    }

    /**
     * File is validated in livewire,
     * so custom rules are empty, the rules related to file validation
     * are passed to the view and then to the component.
     * (see render method)
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        if ($this->model->required) {
            $rules[] = 'required';
        }

        return $rules ?? [];
    }



    public function isFile(): bool
    {
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * @inheritDoc
     */
    public function viewData(): array
    {

        // get allowed mimes from field properties, or use default ones
        // (for retrocompatibility for fields created before mimes property was added)
        $mimesConfig = $this->model->properties['mimes'] ?? [];
        if ($mimesConfig) {
            foreach ($mimesConfig as $mime => $enabled) {
                if ($enabled) {
                    $allowedMimes[] = $mime;
                }
            }
        }
        if (empty($allowedMimes)) {
            $allowedMimes = $this->mimes;
        }

        $data = array_merge(parent::viewData(), [
            'maxSizeInBytes' => self::MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE * 1024,
            'mimes' => $allowedMimes,
            'formField' => $this->model,
            'userActivity' => $this->userActivity,
            'messageType' => $this->messageType,
        ]);

        return $data;
    }

}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Activities\Custom;

use App\Domain\UserActivity\ResponseProcessors\MissioneRobiolaProcessor;
use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\Activity;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Models\UserActivity;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\View\View;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\BinaryFileResponse;

class MissioneRobiolaController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Download the badge for a specific user activity.
     */
    public function badgeDownload(Request $request, int $userActivityId): BinaryFileResponse
    {
        $userActivity = UserActivity::findOrFail($userActivityId);

        abort_if($userActivity->user_id !== $request->user()->id, 403);

        $profile = $userActivity->extra_data['profile'] ?? null;

        if (!$profile) {
            throw new \RuntimeException("UserActivity {$userActivityId} has no profile in extra_data.");
        }

        $path = public_path('img/activities/custom/missione-robiola/badge-' . $profile . '.png');

        if (!file_exists($path)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException("Badge file not found for profile '{$profile}': {$path}");
        }

        return response()->download($path, 'badge-' . $profile . '.png');
    }

    /**
     * Test: simula la thank-you page della Missione Robiola.
     *
     * Query params:
     *   ?profile=robioloso      profilo vincitore da mostrare (default: robioloso)
     *   ?user_id=456            forza un utente specifico (default: User::first())
     */
    public function testTyp(Request $request): View
    {
        $profile = $request->query('profile', 'robioloso');
        $userId  = $request->query('user_id');

        $activity = Activity::where('response_processor_class', MissioneRobiolaProcessor::class)->firstOrFail();

        $user = $userId
            ? User::findOrFail((int) $userId)
            : User::first();

        // Costruisce dei punteggi di esempio con il profilo richiesto come vincitore
        $allProfiles = [$profile, 'altro-profilo'];
        $fakeScores  = array_combine($allProfiles, [5, 2]);

        $fakeUserActivity = new UserActivity([
            'activity_id' => $activity->id,
            'extra_data' => [
                'scores'  => $fakeScores,
                'profile' => $profile,
            ],
        ]);

        $thankYouMessage = __('global.missioneCompletata-txt', ['num' => $activity->prize]);

        return view('activities.custom.missioneRobiola-typ', [
            'activity'        => $activity,
            'user'            => $user,
            'userActivity'    => $fakeUserActivity,
            'progressPercent' => 100,
            'thankYouMessage' => $thankYouMessage,
            'itsTheFirstTime' => true,
        ]);
    }
}

<?php

use App\Http\Middleware\ExcludeSpecialActivities;
use App\Http\Middleware\IpBlock;
use App\Http\Middleware\ProtectLivewireEndpoint;
use Illuminate\Console\Scheduling\Schedule;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Application;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Configuration\Exceptions;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Configuration\Middleware;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Spatie\Health\Commands\DispatchQueueCheckJobsCommand;
use Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\Exception\HttpException;

return Application::configure(basePath: dirname(__DIR__))
    ->withRouting(
        web: [
            __DIR__ . '/../routes/web.php',
            __DIR__ . '/../routes/deployment.php',
        ],
        commands: __DIR__ . '/../routes/console.php',
        health: '/up',
    )
    ->withMiddleware(function (Middleware $middleware) {

        // redirect applied by "auth" middleware
        $middleware->redirectGuestsTo(fn () => route('register'));

        // redirect applied by "guest" middleware
        $middleware->redirectUsersTo(fn () => route('dashboard'));

        // replace default auth middleware with custom one
        $middleware->alias([
            'auth' => \App\Http\Middleware\Authenticate::class,
        ]);

        // manutenzione e coming soon
        $middleware->web(
            prepend: [

                IpBlock::class,
                ProtectLivewireEndpoint::class,

                \Illuminate\Http\Middleware\FrameGuard::class,

                // force app url
                \App\Http\Middleware\ForceAppUrl::class,

                // redirect root
                \AtrioTeam\Lintilla\Http\Middleware\RootRedirectLocale::class,
            ],
            append: [
                \AtrioTeam\Lintilla\Http\Middleware\CustomMaintenanceMode::class,
                \AtrioTeam\Lintilla\Http\Middleware\SetLocale::class,
                ExcludeSpecialActivities::class,

                // abilitare per reindirizzamento automatico con tabella link_redirect
                // \AtrioTeam\Lintilla\Http\Middleware\RedirectCheck::class

            ],
        );

    })
    ->withExceptions(function (Exceptions $exceptions) {

        /**
         * Custom error render for admin routes.
         */
        $exceptions->render(function (HttpException $e, Request $request) {
            $statusCode = $e->getStatusCode();

            if ($request->segment(1) == 'admin') {
                return response()->view('errors.admin', [
                    'code' => $statusCode,
                    'message' => match($statusCode) {
                        404 => 'Pagina non trovata',
                        403 => 'Accesso negato',
                        503 => 'Sito in manutenzione',
                        400 => $e->getMessage(),
                        default => 'Si è verificato un errore',
                    }
                ], $statusCode);
            }
        });

        $logger = app(\App\Exceptions\ExceptionLogger::class);

        // InvalidNewsletterMailException is self-reporting via its report() method (see the class).

        // Permanent SMTP delivery failures (invalid recipient): write to exception_logs as 'monitored', suppress mail notification
        $exceptions->report(app(\App\Exceptions\Reporters\PermanentMailFailureReporter::class));

        // log exception and register lintilla handler for generic error notification
        $exceptions->report(function (Throwable $e) use ($logger) {

            app()->make(\AtrioTeam\Lintilla\Exceptions\Handler::class)->report($e);

            $request = request();
            $logger->log($e, [
                'url'        => $request->fullUrl(),
                'method'     => $request->method(),
                'user_id'    => rescue(fn () => $request->user()?->id, null, false),
                'ip'         => $request->ip(),
                'user_agent' => $request->userAgent(),
                'context'    => [
                    'previous' => $e->getPrevious() ? get_class($e->getPrevious()) : null,
                ],
            ]);
        });

    })
    ->withProviders([
        // event sourcing
        \App\Providers\EventSourcingServiceProvider::class,
        // view
        \App\Providers\ViewServiceProvider::class,
    ])
    ->withSchedule(function (Schedule $schedule) {

        // pulizia cartelle media non cancellate automaticamente
        // $schedule->command('media-library:clean')->hourly();

        if (app()->environment('production')) {
            // stats
            $schedule->command('stats:overview')->everyFourHours();
            $schedule->command('stats:completed-activities')->everyFourHours();

            // dispatcher of a test job to be monitored by the health package
            // @see https://spatie.be/docs/laravel-health/v1/available-checks/queue
            $schedule->command(DispatchQueueCheckJobsCommand::class)->everyMinute()->doNotMonitor();

            // triage failed notification jobs every fifteen minutes
            $schedule->command('app:monitor-notification-jobs')->everyFifteenMinutes();

            // triage failed newsletter jobs every fifteen minutes
            $schedule->command('app:monitor-newsletter-jobs')->everyFifteenMinutes();

            // triage failed Oh Dear ping jobs every fifteen minutes
            $schedule->command('app:monitor-oh-dear-jobs')->everyFifteenMinutes();

            // scadenza annuale dei gettoni: 01/07 alle 00:00 (Europe/Rome),
            // così da includere anche i punti guadagnati il 30/06
            $schedule->command('app:expire-points')
                ->yearlyOn(
                    // @phpstan-ignore argument.type
                    (int) config('business.points.expiry_month'),
                    (int) config('business.points.expiry_day'),
                    '00:00'
                )
                ->timezone('Europe/Rome');

        }

    })

    ->create();

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\UserActivity;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Http\Response;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Intervention\Image\Facades\Image;

class MissioneBorsaFrigoController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Dimensioni (in px) della cornice polaroid, vedi
     * public/img/activities/custom/missione-borsafrigo/polaroid.png
     */
    private const FRAME_WIDTH = 766;
    private const FRAME_HEIGHT = 886;

    /**
     * Riquadro foto dentro la cornice: stesse proporzioni usate
     * nella thank you page (typ.blade.php), scalate 2x per la risoluzione nativa.
     */
    private const PHOTO_WIDTH = 582;
    private const PHOTO_HEIGHT = 616;
    private const PHOTO_OFFSET_X = 96;
    private const PHOTO_OFFSET_Y = 80;

    /**
     * Compone la foto caricata dall'utente con la cornice polaroid
     * e restituisce l'immagine risultante come download.
     */
    public function downloadImage(Request $request, int $userActivityId): Response
    {
        $userActivity = UserActivity::findOrFail($userActivityId);

        abort_if($userActivity->user_id !== $request->user()->id, 403);

        $foto = $userActivity->formResponse->answerByQuestionMeta('borsafrigo', 'foto');

        abort_if(!$foto, 404, 'Nessuna foto trovata per questa missione.');

        $photoPath = Storage::disk('uploads')->path($foto->value);
        $framePath = public_path('img/activities/custom/missione-borsafrigo/polaroid.png');

        $canvas = Image::canvas(self::FRAME_WIDTH, self::FRAME_HEIGHT, '#ffffff');
        $canvas->insert(
            Image::make($photoPath)->fit(self::PHOTO_WIDTH, self::PHOTO_HEIGHT),
            'top-left',
            self::PHOTO_OFFSET_X,
            self::PHOTO_OFFSET_Y
        );
        $canvas->insert(Image::make($framePath), 'top-left', 0, 0);

        $encoded = $canvas->encode('png');

        return response($encoded->getEncoded(), 200, [
            'Content-Type' => 'image/png',
            'Content-Disposition' => 'attachment; filename="la-tua-borsa-frigo.png"',
        ]);
    }
}

```
[WebP Support] => (vuoto)
[GIF Read Support] => 1
```

La build di GD in uso non ha il supporto WebP compilato. Quindi:

- **webp**: `Image::make($userPhotoPath)` in [MissioneBorsaFrigoController.php:53](app/Http/Controllers/Activities/Custom/MissioneBorsaFrigoController.php#L53) lancerebbe un'eccezione (`Intervention\Image\Exception\NotSupportedException`) al tentativo di decodifica → la route di download risponderebbe con un 500, non un errore gestito.
- **gif**: GD lo legge tranquillamente (prende il primo frame se animata) → nessun crash, il badge si genera normalmente.

Quindi la restrizione a jpeg/png che avevamo deciso di applicare via CMS non è solo una preferenza di formato: è l'unica cosa che evita davvero il crash sul webp in questo ambiente (a meno di installare/abilitare il supporto webp in GD, o passare a Imagick).

<?php

namespace App\Domain\UserActivity\ResponseProcessors;

use App\FormBuilder\Models\FormFieldOption;
use App\FormBuilder\Models\FormResponseField;
use App\Models\UserActivity;

class MissioneRobiolaProcessor
{
    public function process(UserActivity $userActivity): void
    {
        $userActivity->loadMissing('formResponse.answers.question.options');

        $scores = [];
        $profileOrder = []; // tracks the order in which profiles first receive points

        /** @var FormResponseField $answer */
        foreach ($userActivity->formResponse->answers as $answer) {

            $field = $answer->question;

            // skip fields that don't have options
            if (!$field->field_type->factory($field)->hasOptions()) {
                continue;
            }

            // normalize answer value(s) to an array
            $chosenValues = is_array($answer->value) ? $answer->value : [$answer->value];

            // find the chosen options and accumulate scores from their meta
            foreach ($field->options as $option) {
                if (!in_array($option->value, $chosenValues, true)) {
                    continue;
                }

                // get points from chosen option meta and accumulate them
                $this->accumulateScores($scores, $profileOrder, $option);
            }
        }

        $profile = $this->determineProfile($scores, $profileOrder);

        $userActivity->extra_data = ['scores' => $scores, 'profile' => $profile];
        $userActivity->save();
    }

    /**
     * Extract score meta keys from an option and add them to the accumulator.
     * Meta keys with prefix "punti-" are treated as profile scores.
     * e.g. a meta key "punti-robio" with value 2 will add 2 points to the "robio" profile.
     *
     * @param array<string, int|float> $scores
     * @param array<int, string> $profileOrder
     */
    private function accumulateScores(array &$scores, array &$profileOrder, FormFieldOption $option): void
    {
        /** @var array<string, mixed>|null $meta */
        $meta = $option->meta;

        if (!is_array($meta)) {
            return;
        }

        foreach ($meta as $key => $value) {
            if (!str_starts_with((string) $key, 'punti-')) {
                continue;
            }

            // extract profile name from meta key, e.g. "punti-robio" => "robio"
            // and stores in profile order if not already there, to determine the winner in case of tie scores
            $profile = substr((string) $key, strlen('punti-'));
            if (!in_array($profile, $profileOrder, true)) {
                $profileOrder[] = $profile;
            }
            $scores[$profile] = ($scores[$profile] ?? 0) + (int) $value;
        }
    }


    /**
     * @param array<string, int|float> $scores
     * @param array<int, string> $profileOrder order in which profiles first received points
     */
    private function determineProfile(array $scores, array $profileOrder): ?string
    {
        if (empty($scores)) {
            return null;
        }

        $maxScore = max($scores);

        // among tied profiles, the one that received a response first wins
        foreach ($profileOrder as $profile) {
            if ($scores[$profile] === $maxScore) {
                return $profile;
            }
        }

        return null;
    }
}

    private const PHOTO_WIDTH = 582;

     * Compone la foto caricata dall'utente con la cornice polaroid
     * e restituisce l'immagine risultante come download.
     */
    public function downloadImage(Request $request, int $userActivityId): Response
    {
        $userActivity = UserActivity::findOrFail($userActivityId);

        abort_if($userActivity->user_id !== $request->user()->id, 403);

        $foto = $userActivity->formResponse->answerByQuestionMeta('borsafrigo', 'foto');

        abort_if(!$foto, 404, 'Nessuna foto trovata per questa missione.');

        $userPhotoPath = Storage::disk('uploads')->path($foto->value);
        $framePath = public_path('img/activities/custom/missione-borsafrigo/polaroid.png');


        // crea frame
        $canvas = Image::canvas(self::FRAME_WIDTH, self::FRAME_HEIGHT, '#ffffff');

        // inserisce immagine utente in frame (modalità "fit")

            Image::make($userPhotoPath)->fit(self::PHOTO_WIDTH, self::PHOTO_HEIGHT),
            'top-left',
            self::PHOTO_OFFSET_X,
            self::PHOTO_OFFSET_Y
        );
        $canvas->insert(Image::make($framePath), 'top-left', 0, 0);

        $encoded = $canvas->encode('png');

        return response($encoded->getEncoded(), 200, [
            'Content-Type' => 'image/png',
            'Content-Disposition' => 'attachment; filename="la-tua-borsa-frigo.png"',
        ]);
    }
}

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Activities\Custom;

use Intervention\Image\Facades\Image;

class MissioneBorsaFrigoController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Dimensioni (in px) della cornice polaroid, vedi
     * public/img/activities/custom/missione-borsafrigo/polaroid.png
     */
    private const FRAME_WIDTH = 766;
    private const FRAME_HEIGHT = 886;

    /**
     * Riquadro foto dentro la cornice: stesse proporzioni usate
     * nella thank you page (typ.blade.php), scalate 2x per la risoluzione nativa.
     */
    private const PHOTO_WIDTH = 582;
    private const PHOTO_HEIGHT = 616;
    private const PHOTO_OFFSET_X = 96;
    private const PHOTO_OFFSET_Y = 80;

    /**
     * Compone la foto caricata dall'utente con la cornice polaroid
     * e restituisce l'immagine risultante come download.
     */
    public function downloadImage(Request $request, int $userActivityId): Response
    {
        $userActivity = UserActivity::findOrFail($userActivityId);

        abort_if($userActivity->user_id !== $request->user()->id, 403);

        $foto = $userActivity->formResponse->answerByQuestionMeta('borsafrigo', 'foto');

        abort_if(!$foto, 404, 'Nessuna foto trovata per questa missione.');

        $userPhotoPath = Storage::disk('uploads')->path($foto->value);
        $framePath = public_path('img/activities/custom/missione-borsafrigo/polaroid.png');


        // crea frame
        $canvas = Image::canvas(self::FRAME_WIDTH, self::FRAME_HEIGHT, '#ffffff');

        // inserisce immagine utente in frame (modalità "fit")
        $canvas->insert(
            Image::make($userPhotoPath)->fit(self::PHOTO_WIDTH, self::PHOTO_HEIGHT),
            'top-left',
            self::PHOTO_OFFSET_X,
            self::PHOTO_OFFSET_Y
        );
        $canvas->insert(Image::make($framePath), 'top-left', 0, 0);

        $encoded = $canvas->encode('png');

        return response($encoded->getEncoded(), 200, [
            'Content-Type' => 'image/png',
            'Content-Disposition' => 'attachment; filename="la-tua-borsa-frigo.png"',
        ]);
    }
}

 * Usato sia dal response processor (generazione al completamento missione)

    private const FRAME_WIDTH = 766;
    private const FRAME_HEIGHT = 886;

     * Riquadro foto dentro la cornice: stesse proporzioni usate

    private const PHOTO_WIDTH = 582;

    private const PHOTO_OFFSET_X = 96;
    private const PHOTO_OFFSET_Y = 80;

    /** Cartella, sul disk "uploads", in cui salvare le immagini composte. */

    /**
     * Compone la foto utente con la cornice e restituisce l'immagine risultante (PNG).
     */
    public function compose(string $userPhotoPath): InterventionImage
    {
        $framePath = public_path('img/activities/custom/missione-borsafrigo/polaroid.png');

        $canvas = Image::canvas(self::FRAME_WIDTH, self::FRAME_HEIGHT, '#ffffff');

        $canvas->insert(
            Image::make($userPhotoPath)->fit(self::PHOTO_WIDTH, self::PHOTO_HEIGHT),
            'top-left',
            self::PHOTO_OFFSET_X,
            self::PHOTO_OFFSET_Y
        );
        $canvas->insert(Image::make($framePath), 'top-left', 0, 0);

        return $canvas->encode('png');
    }

    /**
     * Compone la polaroid per una user activity e la salva sul disk "uploads".
     * Ritorna il path relativo salvato, o null se l'utente non ha caricato una foto.
     */
    public function composeAndStore(UserActivity $userActivity): ?string

        $foto = $userActivity->formResponse?->answerByQuestionMeta('borsafrigo', 'foto');

        if (!$foto) {
            return null;
        }

        $userPhotoPath = Storage::disk('uploads')->path($foto->value);

        $composed = $this->compose($userPhotoPath);

        $relativePath = self::STORAGE_FOLDER . '/' . $userActivity->id . '.png';

        Storage::disk('uploads')->put($relativePath, (string) $composed);

        return $relativePath;
    }
}
